sources.title: Rate limiting overview
sources.description: Sliding window limiter. On limit exceeded the API returns a 429 status and an X-RateLimit-Reset header.

sources.title: Client retry guidance
sources.description: Clients should honor Retry-After and back off exponentially, adding random jitter to retry delays.

children.name: What counts as a request

topics.content: When a limit is exceeded the API returns a 429 status and an X-RateLimit-Reset header.

children.name: Backing off
